notes:
High-level: Looking to move real-time personalization + chat to Redwood Dedicated. Primary drivers: predictable latency for sub-100ms routing on critical flows and cost predictability at scale.

-- Sizing ask: would like Redwood to produce baseline capacity plan (QPS -> GPUs) for steady-state + 3x peak spikes. Will provide 2 weeks of traffic logs and token distribution.

-- Goals: 75th/95th latency SLOs (p50 target 40-60ms, p95 < 120ms for interactive chat); throughput target 1200 QPS steady; peak burst up to 4500 QPS during promotions. Token/sec estimate: steady 150k tok/sec, peak 540k tok/sec.

-- Model stack: 70% chat assistant (mix of instruction + system prompts), 20% reranking, 10% embeddings. Preferred models: Llama3-70B quantized variant for cost reasons; fallback to 13B sharded copies in constrained times. Need model routing by cost/latency.

-- Security/compliance: EU data residency must be demonstrable, SAML SSO, SOC2/ISO27001 posture required. Request for HSM integration for key wrap called out in security review.

-- Pricing sensitivity: procurement pushing for committed reserved GPUs vs burst credits; economics will drive decision. AE pushed possibility of blended dedicated + hosted fallback to reduce commit.

-- Quote from CTO: "We can't degrade the live experience during Black Friday — we need hard throughput guarantees or a safe fallback plan."

-- Previous interactions: Security questionnaire sent 2026-03-01 (SEC-8721), first sizing kickoff 2026-03-02 (Fireflies ff_2026-03-02_verdigris_kickoff), follow-up POC discussion 2026-03-09. SE to run microbenchmarks with customer sample logs by 2026-03-17.
